violation_type.title: Special Diets - Employees given information (26 TAC §746.3311(a)(3))
violation_type.typical_finding: There is enough evidence to support that the operation was not following Minimum Standards regarding providing all employees who prepare and serve food special diet requirements of the children in care.

finding_variants.text: There is enough evidence to support that the operation was not following Minimum Standards regarding providing all employees who prepare and serve food special diet requirements of the children in care.
Information was not communicated between caregivers and meal serving staff about the dietary restrictions for child resulting in the child receiving the wrong food.
Based on information obtained during the investigation, the operation failed to give caregiver the special diet for children in care.
